CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, July 16, 2025 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “C”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE JUNE 18, 2025 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS

  V.  STAFF REPORT

 VI.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until adopted by the  July 16, 2025
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, June 18, 2025
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:09 P.M. on Wednesday, June 18, 2025 at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, Conference Room “A”.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: President Canseco, Vice President Saunders, and Commission
Member Hermano.
Commission Members Absent: Commission Member Navarro.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Houghton and Clerical Assistant II
Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF THE MARCH 19, 2025 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING MINUTES
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second from Commission Member Hermano,
the March 19, 2025 minutes were approved as written.

ELECTION OF OFFICERS
President Canseco and Vice President Saunders.

ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS
City staff will verify utility boxes and return with utility box identification for Vice President
Saunders at the next Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting.

President Canseco is researching inclusive multiple ethnic and heritage background poles for
Main Street; Vice President Saunders will provide President Canseco with contact information
for a possible vendor.

STAFF REPORT
The Alhambra City Art and Cultural Events Commission approved the following exhibitions for
display in the Alhambra City Hall Lobby: Stephanie Petteplace “Of Colors and Forms” for
October 2025, Leonora Brown “Travels of my Aunt” for November 2025, and WeArt5 for
March 2026.

Deputy Director Houghton invited the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission and
their families to attend an upcoming summer community event. Deputy Director Houghton
provided event details for the summer concerts and movie series at Alhambra Park and annual
Fourth of July Celebration at Almansor Park.
 Director Macias shared final imagery for the 2026 Tournament of Roses Parade Alhambra float
design and Story Park Stormwater Capture Project with the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural
Events Commission. President Canseco will submit a letter of support on behalf of the Alhambra
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission to Latoya Waters, Deputy Director of Utilities for the
Story Park Stormwater Capture Project. Director Macias invited the Alhambra City Arts and
Cultural Events Commission to attend the upcoming Almansor Park placemaking signs ribbon
cutting ceremony on June 25th.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
No public communication requests received.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by President Canseco and a second by Vice President Saunders, the June 18, 2025
City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:29 P.M.
